newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DEBT FUTURES END DOWN SHARPLY IN HEAVY TRADE.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DEBT FUTURES END DOWN SHARPLY IN HEAVY TRADE.

text.p: Aug 8 - U.S. debt futures ended sharply lower after a session of technical weakness and heavy volume. Sept T-bonds fell to 5-wk low, found some buying on the low to stabilize prices into the close. Traders said one firm sold 20,000 September 5-year notes. Hedge fund sales, sell-stops and talk of central bank and Japanese selling exacerbated the dim tone.
